include_rule: path whitelist over the translated bzip2 *library* sources (the transpilation of bzlib.c and the files it compiles with: blocksort.c, compress.c, crctable.c, decompress.c, huffman.c, randtable.c)

exclude.bzip2.rs: translated CLI *program* (bzip2.c), not the library; it is the adapter path through which the shipped suite reaches the library
exclude.bzip2recover.rs: separate translated program (bzip2recover.c); exercised by neither side
exclude.src/bin/bzip2cli.rs: test adapter written for this experiment
exclude.src/bin/covreplay.rs: replay driver written for this experiment

notes: crctable.rs and randtable.rs are in scope but contain no functions (pure static tables), so they contribute 0 to both the function and the region denominator; llvm-cov omits them from its reports for that reason.
The same scope and the same denominator are used for both sides.
